options.name: Nocturne Console
options.summary: Dark, monospaced operator console for high-volume triage: phosphor-green accents on near-black, square edges, keyboard shortcuts (1-4), dense rows and retrieval-score readouts. Optimized for an analyst who lives in the queue all day.
options.typography: System monospace throughout (SF Mono / Menlo / Consolas), uppercase micro-labels

options.name: Atrium
options.summary: Editorial reading room in ink-on-cream: serif display type, centered single column, hairline rules and generous air. Frames each draft as a letter to be read carefully before it is signed — leans into the approval gate as an act of judgement.
options.typography: Iowan Old Style / Palatino serif for display, Optima / Avenir humanist sans for body

options.name: Pulse
options.summary: Bright modern product UI: electric indigo gradient headers, geometric sans, 16px rounded cards with soft depth, chat bubbles and pill buttons. Icon rail navigation, friendly voice — the most familiar-feeling SaaS direction.
options.typography: Inter / SF Pro geometric sans, tight tracking, bold weights for hierarchy

options.name: Ledger
options.summary: Institutional record-keeping surface: navy chrome, zero-radius flat panels, small-caps section legends, faceted filters and tabular data with monospaced timestamps. Treats every conversation as an auditable record for later quality review.
options.typography: Helvetica Neue / Arial grotesque with letterspaced uppercase labels, monospace for numerics
